answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 837 Country: Pakistan Title: We have toys shop and there are different types and shapes of toys in animals we have dog, cat, tiger, lion, parrot, bhaloo, dolls and other toys like cars, trucks that have music. I want to know is this business is Jaiz in Sharia? Question: We have toys shop and there are different types and shapes of toys in animals we have dog, cat, tiger, lion, parrot, bhaloo, dolls and other toys like cars, trucks that have music. I want to know is this business is Jaiz in Sharia? Answer ID: 837 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 440/428/N) Dealing in musical toys and toys of living being is impermissible: لقولہ علیہ السلام: ولاتعاونوا علی الاثم والعدوان واتقوا اللہ (الآیة) ان ما قامت المعصیة بعینہ یکرہ بیعہ تحریماً والا فتنزیھاً (درمختار: 9/561) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
